entitlements_activated.description: True only when the same settlement transaction committed its exact plan or additional-licence effect.

paid.description: True only for an atomic SETTLED accounting effect.

buyer_name.description: Null means unknown, not a fabricated buyer.

closes_at.description: Explicit interpreted instant, normalized to UTC. Null/absent means unknown. Not source verification or a Bidora-controlled cutoff.

source_date_text.description: Original source wording; retain ambiguous text even without an interpreted instant. Plain untrusted text, never HTML.

source_document_version_id.description: Exact document-version reference. Must pass current tenant/access/eligibility checks through the document-owner interface. No object keys or current-version substitution.

source_timezone.description: Raw source zone may be unresolved when closes_at is null. An interpreted instant requires a recognized IANA region or UTC.

source_uri.description: HTTP(S)-only descriptive provenance. Semantic validation rejects userinfo and non-HTTP(S) schemes. Never fetch, follow redirects, normalize away original wording or log this value.

title.description: Approved request bound; preserve wording, do not silently trim.

manual_capture__ExternalTenderImportedV1.description: Proposed event schema, not an accepted broker contract. IDs are provenance, not bearer authority. No source text, URL, pricing or document bytes in payload.

capabilities.description: Current explicit Platform Administration capabilities for an eligible PLATFORM_ADMIN account; empty for other account types and for primary-only rotated administrator sessions awaiting reauthentication. Every platform operation still rechecks current authority.

platform_context_generation.description: Non-null only for an eligible PLATFORM_ADMIN account. It is a stale-context selector for platform APIs, never authority.

secret.description: Raw TOTP secret returned only while enrollment is pending; never log or persist in a browser.

token.description: Secret invitation link context plus six digits, or a legacy strong token. Retains expiry, one-time use, email binding and rate limits.

assignments.description: Latest assignment state for each fixed role; use assignment-history for immutable prior versions.

expires_at.description: Null while a Platform Owner invitation awaits maker/checker approval; active invitations expire 72 hours after activation.

first_name.description: Immutable invitation name; empty on historical invitations.

last_name.description: Immutable invitation name; empty on historical invitations.

first_name.description: First name, at most 100 UTF-8 bytes. Supply with last_name.

last_name.description: Last name, at most 100 UTF-8 bytes. Supply with first_name.

reason.description: Optional legacy audit reason; omitted reasons use the server-generated Platform administrator invitation reason.

assigned_by.description: Null only for the deployment bootstrap assignment, which has no human actor.

administrator_id.description: Actor ID only; null for system-originated records

administrator_name.description: Current identity name, email fallback or honest system/unknown label; not a historical name snapshot.

affected_record_id.description: Only invitation, change or integration-version UUIDs; null for user-targeted actions

browser.description: Informational browser name derived from untrusted User-Agent; same access and retention as IP.

changes.description: Explicitly allowlisted recorded changes; empty for historical/unsupported details. Secrets are change markers only, never values.

ip_address.description: Restricted, retention-limited client IP; requires platform.security.event.read in addition to audit-read. Null when missing, expired or not permitted.

client_id.description: Empty only while disabled; otherwise the exact deployed Google OAuth client ID.

client_secret.description: Replacement only. Omit to preserve; null/empty is invalid. Required when changing a configured client ID or first enabling.

contact_phone.description: Optional phone; empty string clears it.

platform_integration_settings__CreateOpe.description: Omitted replacements retain exact-active references transactionally; the first revision requires key and CA roots. Enabled=false is an explicitly testable pause. Environment credentials are ignored.

platform_integration_settings__CreatePes.description: Both replacements or retention of the exact-active encrypted pair. No caller-selected API/callback URL, callback registration, order, refund or settlement command.

notification_id.description: Pre-registered IPN UUID; empty only when disabled.

password.description: Required for first configuration or credential replacement; empty only with retain_credentials.

retain_credentials.description: Keep the exact expected active SMTP credentials and trust configuration. Requires an empty password and unchanged username.

trust_roots_pem.description: Required on replacement; ignored when exact stored SMTP credentials/trust are retained.

pending_change_id.description: Authorized pending request linked to this saved OpenAI or PesaPal version; no manual reference entry is needed.

platform_integration_settings__ProviderT.description: OPENAI requires confirm_billable_test:true; SMTP/PESAPAL accept reason only.

username.description: Login name populated only for the current authorized SMTP form; never returns the password.

maintenance_message.description: Single-line public message, required when maintenance is enabled; at most 240 UTF-8 bytes.

restricted_metadata_retention_days.description: Development restricted metadata visibility, not production retention or physical deletion.

maintenance_ends_at.description: RFC3339 with explicit offset (normalized UTC), or empty string; must follow start.

maintenance_message.description: Single-line public message, required when maintenance is enabled; at most 240 UTF-8 bytes.

maintenance_starts_at.description: RFC3339 with explicit offset (normalized UTC), or empty string for no bound.

restricted_metadata_retention_days.description: Development restricted metadata visibility, not production retention or physical deletion.

browser.description: Untrusted browser header; not a device identity or authorization fact.

step_up_seconds.description: Sensitive Platform action verification window, default 900 seconds. Omission in legacy requests preserves the saved value; ordinary navigation does not use this timer.

assignment_generation.description: Operational generation only; never a database selector or authority.

assignment_present.description: Whether a matching active server-side assignment and active cluster record exist. No locator is exposed and this does not claim complete tenant readiness.
